steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yahoo!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Eyes on the road, Exusiai! Hands on ten and two!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I finally caught you.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas... please... slower next time...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: S- sorry. I was holding back as much as I could.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But at least we're all back together. Now we gotta go find the boss.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Wait, why do I feel like we're missing something?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...where's Bison?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What? Wasn't he with you guys?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: ...We didn't leave him back there did we?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...We're so used to doing things our own way, leaving him behind was kind of inevitable.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: So then we should probably go back and get him?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Isn't Mostima here? I think he'll be okay.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Hey! W- waait up! *Cough* *hack*

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: ...A bicycle?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Wowee! If you'n keep up with Texas on a bicycle, yer somethin' else, Bison!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Hey! Which alley'd he go down?!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: That way!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: He's got a lot of guys on his tail.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Let's not be too hard on the kid who shook off a crew of armed mobsters on a bicycle.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...No, it's an ambush. Exusiai!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: A little late for that!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Nng!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I did it! I caught them!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Sure did. Thanks for leading the way.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Who——

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Good night, sweet prince.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oof.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Damn. A second too late.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Good evening, Penguin Logistics. I am Gambino Ricci, head of the Family.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: And it looks like I've got a hostage.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: But you ain't gonna make a scene over a little thing like this, eh?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: We left him behind...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ain't that the honest truth.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hmph... I'm sick of you scuttling around like cockroaches, getting into my business, makin' yourselves a real pain in my tail.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: That's the value of the little prince here. I got a hostage and all you can do is take me head on.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: And that'll save me a lotta trouble. That turns my little penguin problem into a very solvable problem.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Penguin Logistics got nowhere to run.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yeah, okay. Great. Just the way I like it.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Turns out we're thinking in the same direction.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Croissant, Sora, form up.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Exusiai, cover us.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Let's get our Bison back.
